label: Folding, merging and cleaning
subgoals: Fold constant cells and simple identities with opt_expr
Sweep unused cells and wires with opt_clean

label: Multiplexers and flip-flops
subgoals: Remove unreachable multiplexer inputs with opt_muxtree
Turn constant-input flip-flops into constants with opt_dff
Fold feedback multiplexers into enable flip-flops

label: Flattening and pass ordering
subgoals: Flatten before optimizing to expose cross-boundary constants
Rerun opt after every lowering step
